title: Mag4: An Automated First-Principles Workflow to Extract Magnetic Interactions, from Pair Couplings to Four-Spin Ring Exchange
summary: Chemists design magnetic materials through structure-property relationships built on pairwise exchange couplings $J$, now extracted routinely from first principles by energy-mapping. But wherever four magnetic centers close a loop---as in cuprate CuO$_2$ planes or infinite-layer square nets---a four-spin ring exchange $J_{\rm ring}$ can arise, reshaping ground states and corrupting the $J$ values used for design. Missing has been a direct, local way to obtain it, as the four-state method gives for $J$. We supply it by generalizing that method to a sixteen-state ($2^4$) scheme, automated in…
